title: Veo 3 Pricing 2026: API Costs, Plans and Access
summary: Veo 3 pricing offers multiple tiers with daily video limits and per-second API rates. See what each tier includes and how to access the free version.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Does Veo 3 cost extra for audio?


It depends on the access route, so check the price line for the exact model variant you plan to call. Google has offered Veo 3 versions with and without generated sound, and on the API those can be priced differently.


In practice, if your clip needs dialogue or sound effects, price the audio-enabled variant. If you'll replace the soundtrack in editing anyway, the cheaper silent option is the one to use in your cost-per-usable-clip math.


### Can I use Veo 3 clips commercially on every plan?


Not safely assumed. Commercial rights are set by the terms attached to each plan or API agreement, and consumer subscriptions, workspace plans and developer access are governed by different documents.


Read the terms for the specific tier you are paying for before a clip goes into client work or an ad.


If the language is ambiguous, ask Google support in writing and keep the reply. A verbal or forum answer won't help you if a client asks where your rights come from.


### Do unused Veo 3 credits roll over?


Treat them as expiring unless your plan documentation says otherwise. Credits attached to a subscription are typically tied to the billing period, so unspent ones are money you paid for and never converted into clips.


That matters for the real-cost argument: a low-usage month raises your cost per usable clip, because the fixed fee is spread over fewer finished results.


Look for the reset and expiry wording on your own plan page, not a summary on a third-party blog.


### Is Veo 3 Fast good enough for final video?


Sometimes, and the only reliable test is your own footage. The Fast variant trades some fidelity and consistency for lower cost and quicker turnaround, which makes it a good fit for drafts, storyboards and social clips viewed on a phone.


If the shot is a hero shot, run a small batch on both variants and count how many outputs you'd actually publish. If Fast needs noticeably more retries to reach the same keeper, its lower price may not produce a lower cost per usable clip.


### How often does Google change Veo 3 pricing?


Often enough that you shouldn't build a budget on a number you copied months ago.


Google has adjusted plans, limits and model variants repeatedly as the product has moved from preview to wider release, and quota changes can arrive without the fanfare a price change gets.


Re-check the official pricing page and your account's quota screen before each project, and record the date you checked next to any figure in your spreadsheet.
